verdict.rationale: vLLM's first-party docs explicitly list GGUF among its supported quantization formats, alongside GPTQ/AWQ, FP8 and others, so loading and running GGUF models is a documented capability. The evidence is only a one-line feature-list mention. missing for 10: dedicated GGUF loading/usage documentation (e.g. how to point vLLM at a .gguf file, tokenizer handling, supported architectures), details on GGUF quantization-type coverage and performance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of GGUF runs.
